create_mask_from_index: create a Mask from a single index using Mask.from_index to represent a specific user
create_mask_from_indices: create a Mask from a list of indices using Mask.from_indices to represent multiple users
create_mask_all_except_index: create a Mask for all indices except one using Mask.all_except_index to exclude a user
create_users_instance: create a Users instance with a max user count and optionally activate all users on init
iterate_active_user_indices: iterate over active user indices using Users.indices with a Mask to filter which users to process
